scope: Credential-free harness probe of the real Kimi Code CLI binary. NOT a canary.

not_a_canary.statement: No model ever ran. Every provider call in this file failed at the transport or config layer on purpose. This file proves the #8561 adapter targets the pinned CLI's real surface; it proves NOTHING about a model completing a task.
not_a_canary.missing_acceptance_criterion: #8561's live canary: a read/edit/test task in a disposable checkout with a real Kimi/Moonshot credential, plus its own receipt in the shape of native-harness-canary-2026-09-19.json.
not_a_canary.reason_not_performed: No Kimi subscription credential and no Moonshot platform API key exist in the environment this adapter was built in. A receipt was deliberately not fabricated.

observations.name: flag-surface

findings.prompt_flag: -p, --prompt <prompt>  Run one prompt non-interactively and print the response.
findings.model_flag: -m, --model <model>  LLM model alias to use for this invocation. Defaults to default_model in config.toml.
findings.output_format_flag: --output-format <format>  Output format for prompt mode. Defaults to text. (choices: "text", "stream-json")

observations.adapter_consequence: There is no --input-format flag on 2.0.2, so Pi/OpenCode's stdin prompt-delivery route (#8506) has no Kimi equivalent. The prompt rides on -p's argv value and the adapter pins the child's stdin to null.

observations.name: print-mode-flag-exclusivity
observations.adapter_consequence: The adapter never emits --yolo/--auto/--plan; -p already implies auto-approval. Loom's --dangerously-skip-permissions is a silent no-op for Kimi.

observations.name: unknown-flag-is-not-tolerated
observations.adapter_consequence: Forwarding Loom's flag would hard-fail the launch, so it must be dropped, not passed through.

observations.name: no-credential-permanent-failure
observations.observed_stderr: error: failed to run prompt: No model configured. Run `kimi` and use /login to sign in, then retry; or set default_model in config.toml.
observations.adapter_consequence: stream-json is genuine NDJSON and emits a system.version meta event first, even on a failing run.

observations.name: env-family-model-route
observations.provider_type_validation_message: KIMI_MODEL_PROVIDER_TYPE must be one of kimi, anthropic, openai, got "...".
observations.observed: A launch with KIMI_MODEL_NAME/KIMI_MODEL_API_KEY/KIMI_MODEL_PROVIDER_TYPE=openai/KIMI_MODEL_BASE_URL pointed at a local stub reached the HTTP layer, confirming the config-free env family resolves a model with no config.toml present.
observations.adapter_consequence: The API-key profile route (credentialEnv + credentialTargets.kimi + providerOptions.kimi) maps onto a real, working mechanism. The secret is injected as env only.

observations.name: config-alias-model-route
observed: kimi doctor -> exit 0, 'OK config.toml', 'All checked config files are valid.'
-m trial-alias -> alias resolved to [models.trial-alias]; failed only on a missing required field: 'Model "trial-alias" must define a positive max_context_size in config.toml.'
-m no-such-alias -> 'Model "no-such-alias" is not configured in config.toml.'
observations.adapter_consequence: -m <alias> resolves against [models.<alias>] in the operator's own config.toml, confirming the subscription/config-alias profile route (providers.kimi = alias, no credentialEnv).

observations.name: thinking-effort-is-NOT-validated-by-the-cli
observations.observed: Accepted. The launch proceeded to contact the provider instead of rejecting the value; the variable binds through an unconstrained optional string schema field (thinking.forcedEffort).
observations.adapter_consequence: The adapter validates the five levels itself and fails closed at 78, because the CLI will not.

observations.name: exit-codes-the-vendor-75-does-not-exist

rate_limit_probe.setup: local HTTP stub returning 429 {"error":{"message":"rate limit exceeded","type":"rate_limit_error"}} as the KIMI_MODEL_BASE_URL provider
rate_limit_probe.retry_ladder: 10 in-process attempts with exponential backoff, ~150s total
rate_limit_probe.observed_stderr: error: failed to run prompt: provider.rate_limit: 429 rate limit exceeded

observations.conclusion: Kimi 2.0.2 never exits 75. It absorbs transients in-process and surfaces only the exhaustion of its own retry ladder, as exit 1. No 75 mapping and no _classify_error_kimi table were added. classify_error's generic transient table already returns RECOVERABLE for the exhaustion text (it matches both '429' and 'rate.limit'), pinned by defaults/scripts/tests/test-classify-error.sh.

observations.name: kimi-code-home-relocation
observations.observed: With KIMI_CODE_HOME set, config.toml, logs (logs/kimi-code.log) and credentials all resolve under that root; kimi doctor reports the relocated paths.
observations.adapter_consequence: Per-account KIMI_CODE_HOME rotation is mechanically viable for the account-pool follow-up (#8563). This adapter does not set it.

automated_tests.note: These drive the real spawn-worker path against a fixture harness binary, not against the kimi binary probed above.
